The initial visit was in the late afternoon, and she was able to see a nurse quite quickly without too much waiting.
The nurse was unable to treat my wife as she believed it could be a bite from an infected tick, so she recommended that my wife should call 111 and mention that she has been advised by the nurse to see an out-of-hours emergency doctor, who would be available from 8pm at Tremadog.
Around 7:30pm we had a callback from the nurse we had seen earlier, encouraging us to call 111 as she had logged my wife's details onto the system, so that they would be ready for an incoming call.
We then made the call, and within minutes of doing so, we received a call back from the out-of-hours doctor. He said that we could come back to the hospital immediately (only 10 minutes by car) and he would see us.
The service and treatment that he gave my wife was fantastic!
He examined her leg, and diagnosed cellulitis, from the insect bite which had occurred a week earlier. As it was very sore and spreading, he was wary that it could trigger sepsis, so he had no hesitation in immediately putting her on to a double strength dose of antibiotics. Following the 7 day course, thankfully the symptoms and the rash had subsided.
We cannot thank the doctor and nurses at that hospital enough. Simply fantastic service, and I must say even much better than the service that my wife received back home in Wolverhampton at the local walk-in centre.
If you're on holiday near to Tremadog and you require a minor emergency medical treatment or consultation, don't worry, you'll be well looked after at this hospital
